notes.title: A short demonstration video
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, it's been a while since there was any news![/p][p]First of all, I would like to thank everyone who has followed the game to some extent or another. There have been many different events in my life and in the world in general (not always pleasant). Unfortunately, the development of the game has turned into an endless long-term project. There were periods of inspiration, followed by downturns when I wanted to give up and completely lost interest. I poured all my strength and nerves into this project, investing about 400 thousand rubles (around $3,500–4,000), and this is the biggest and most significant project in my life. I want to apologize for the long development time and endless delays, but guys, believe me, developing games when you're doing it alone and it's not your main job is hard. I would even say it's a feat. Of course, a game of this kind could have been developed easily in two years rather than 5-6 if you know how and what you want)...[/p][p]At the moment, the game is almost finished and in the polishing stage. I won't specify any release dates; I’ll only say that it’s not as long as it already took. And for the release, I’ve prepared a small contest for everyone that will definitely appeal to you. But this surprise unfortunately for ru audience only. Sorry, my foreign friends.[/p][p]Here are in-game all guns demostration: [/p][previewyoutube="bNY33zc1fNs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I am often accused of having cool and atmospheric trailers, but people ask: what will the game itself look like, which you've been working on for so long? Well, fair enough, so I decided to record some gameplay on the "working arena." I based it on the advanced locomotion system v4 (those familiar with Unreal will understand what I mean). It’s a very flexible animation system for third-person character control (I’d say it’s the best I’ve seen on the marketplace), which I customized for my project. And here’s what came out) The weapons in the game are only domestic manufacturers. We will be fighting enemies with:[/p][p]Tokarev (Alek’s main weapon)[/p][p]Makarov (the weakest pistol in the game)[/p][p]Stechkin with a silencer (when you already have two pistols, the third should be somewhat different; yes, I know that APS has automatic fire, but there are already many automatic weapons in the game)[/p][p]Ithaca 37 pump-action shotgun, typical of 90s shootouts[/p][p]VSS – will appear only once but shooting from it will be incredibly satisfying[/p][p]SKS – same story, appears only once but with an interesting feature at that level[/p][p]AKSU – one of the main assault rifles; also a nod to the 90s[/p][p]AK74 – heavy artillery and the most powerful automatic rifle. Don’t worry—you’ll get plenty of shooting from it.[/p][p]I think this is more than enough to bring your enemies to judgment day. The enemies are mainly various gangsters, but there will also be special forces and even masked killers.[/p]

notes.title: КНИГА ALEK!
notes.notes:
Friends, I'm happy to announce that I have ALEK in the works! 

It's a thriller about the adventures of Alec and his associates. I thought that much of what I wanted to tell about these characters would not fit only in the game, because, after all, the game is primarily entertainment. The game needs more action and a lot of what the game won't include (precisely because of the format) will appear in the book. In general, it will be the same story, only much richer and much more extensive. Feelings and experiences will be described, more will be said about the characters and their motivations. Alec's friends will play a prominent role in the book. 

I think the book will be released much earlier than the game. Firstly, to fuel interest, and secondly, it will help players catch the right mood and properly dip into the 90's. I don't want the game to be seen as an adaptation (of sorts) of a book or the book to be considered written (based on the game, like my previous book "35 MM"). It's one big story. 

Subscribe to my instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/vitalii_writer/]vitalii_writer[/url]  

Stay tuned, I'll let you know if anything interesting happens! Good luck everyone!

notes.title: Моя Книга "35 ММ"
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, friends! I present to your attention my second book "35 MM". It is a literary adaptation of the game of the same name by Sergey Noskov. The game made a serious impression on me, so I decided to write a short novel based on it. In it I transformed the game's plot into a literary form, added storylines, characters, rethought some events. 

And at the end there will be a surprise for fans: an interview with game developer Sergey Noskov. 

At the moment the book is only available on Ridero, but will soon be released on LitRes and Ozon
